newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals recover on reduced supplies.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals recover on reduced supplies.

text.p: Base metals recovered some of the recent losses on the local market on Monday, dealers said.
"Industrial demand remained low but limited arrivals helped sa modest rally in the prices," a dealer said. Arrivals by sea fell after shipping schedules were revised on cyclone fears.

Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 11,700 rupees per quintal. Nickel rose by 200 rupees to 37,400 rupees and tin rose by 100 rupees to 35,500 rupees per quintal. Last week tin and nickel were down by 100 rupees each. Lead was quiet at 4,850 rupees per quintal while zinc rose by 25 rupees at 6,250 rupees and aluminium rose by 25 rupees to 7,225 rupees per quintal.
